def: Google's open-source (Apache 2.0) terminal coding agent, launched in June 2025 and configured with GEMINI.md files, layered settings, extensions and hooks.
practice: Since 18 June 2026 it no longer serves Google AI Pro, Ultra or free Code Assist users, who were moved to Antigravity CLI; it still works with paid Gemini API keys and Code Assist Standard or Enterprise licenses (as of November 2026).
